content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in McKinney

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMI Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's full criteria and gather documentation of your work history before applying. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify eligibility questions at no cost.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions at times that fit your McKinney schedule; no travel required. You'll master the PMBOK framework and exam domains while earning the contact hours PMI mandates before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of education and project experience. Pay PMI's exam fee at that time. Granite PM Academy provides step-by-step guidance on the application process so you avoid delays or errors.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy's instructors support your exam readiness through practice questions, mock exams, and focused review of high-difficulty topics. Schedule your exam when you feel confident. Most candidates sit for the computer-delivered test at a testing center near McKinney within weeks of completing the course.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you'll renew every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy and PMI offer many low-cost or free PDU opportunities—webinars, articles, volunteer work, and continuing education—so maintaining your credential fits any budget and schedule.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
